verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents an official 'Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI' that mirrors the IDE extension features—agent/app creation from templates, resource provisioning/deployment to Azure, and validation/packaging/publishing via CLI commands—directly supporting AI-native, agent-centric development workflows for Teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in real-world use, and no mention of broader scripting/automation ecosystem beyond the toolkit docs.
